news.label: Bambu Lab's first 3D scanner
details: The S1 is a wireless 3D scanner with three blue laser modes and an infrared mode.
The accuracy is a stated single-frame figure, measured under the maker's test conditions. Real-world verification is still needed.

lines.say: First up, Bambu Lab's very first three D scanner, the S one.
lines.show: First up, Bambu Lab's very first 3D scanner, the S1.

lines.say: It works wirelessly, and the laser accuracy is said to reach zero point zero two millimeters.
lines.show: It works wirelessly, and laser accuracy is said to reach 0.02mm.

lines.say: Capturing a real object and tweaking it sounds like a lot of fun.
lines.show: Capturing a real object and tweaking it sounds like a lot of fun.

link.title: Easy in Hand, Pro in Every Scan: Bambu Lab introduces the S1 3D scanner
link.description: Professional scan processing without additional licenses

news.label: 27B model in 5.9GB released
details: It's a ternary-weight model based on Qwen3.8 27B, released under the Apache 2.0 license.
On the official SWE-bench Verified evaluation, it improved from 60.8 for the previous generation to 75.6.
You can run it with llama.cpp on NVIDIA and Intel GPUs, and with MLX on Apple devices.

lines.say: Next, local A I: Ternary Bonsai two point five.
A twenty-seven billion parameter model now fits in five point nine gigabytes.
lines.show: A 27 billion parameter model now fits in 5.9GB.

lines.say: It's great that it might run on a regular G P U.
lines.show: It's great that it might run on a regular GPU.

news.label: Bambu Lab P3C pre-orders open
points: Material switch in as little as 6 seconds
details: Five tools come standard, and going up to seven requires additional purchases.
These are the manufacturer's stated figures. Cutting, drawing, and debossing are also supported as options.
APPLE TREE has opened pre-orders in Japan. The US price is $1,149.

lines.say: One more from Bambu Lab: pre-orders for the P three C have started in Japan.

lines.say: It supports up to seven tools, and switching materials takes as little as six seconds.

lines.say: That opens up ways to play beyond just changing colors.

details: Anthropic has released a beta feature that turns Artifacts into desktop apps.
With your permission, they can also use global shortcuts, work with files, and run programs.
Requests to Claude count against your plan's usage limits.

news.label: skyACE links LiDAR to design
points: Scanned 200 sq m in about 7 minutes
details: Scan2BIM generates 2D drawings with dimensions and 3D models.
It connects with VinaCAD Web Engine and can export DXF drawings.
A case study of scanning an office of about 200 square meters has been published.
